::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
df_url="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jmayberr/math133-stat-learning-fall2026/refs/heads/main/Datasets/womenShots.csv"
shots=read.csv(df_url) %>%
  select(-X.1,-X,-start.time,-end.time,-category)
formula=factor(Goal)~abs(xj)+yj+Hand+Tactic+Type+Defense
```
:::


Fit nnet


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(nnet)
shot_nnet=nnet(formula,
               data=shots,
               size=8,
               trace=FALSE)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
yhat=predict(shot_nnet,shots,type="class")
table(shots$Goal,yhat) #Confusion matrix
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
          yhat
           Goal Not Goal
  Goal      316      277
  Not Goal   97      917
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}
sum(yhat==shots$Goal)/nrow(shots) #accuracy
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 0.7672682
```


:::
:::


PLotting decision boundary example:


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
grid=expand.grid(
  xj=seq(min(shots$xj)-0.5,max(shots$xj)+0.5,by=0.01),
  yj=seq(min(shots$yj)-0.5,max(shots$yj)+0.5,by=0.01),
  Hand="Right",
  Tactic="Perimeter",
  Type="Normal",
  Defense="Contested"
)

grid=grid |>
  mutate(yhat=predict(shot_nnet,newdata=grid,type="class"))
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ggplot()+
  geom_raster(
    data=grid,
    aes(x=xj,y=yj,fill=yhat),
    alpha=0.2
  )+
  geom_point(
    data=dplyr::filter(shots,Hand=="Right",Type=="Normal",
                       Tactic=="Perimeter",
                       Defense=="Contested"),
    aes(x=xj,y=yj,color=Goal)
  )
```
